title: Montagnier DNA water teleportation confirmed in witnessed experiments
plain: Dave Rossi, a man who says aliens taught him advanced physics, refers to a paper by a French scientist, Luc Montagnier, claiming that the signal of DNA can be passed into water at a distance, which he calls teleportation. Rossi says he has personally witnessed lab experiments in private laboratories that confirm it. If true, it would mean biology and water behave in ways mainstream science does not accept.
